assumptions.statement: 提交的总体设计范围与三处重点区域均为依据公告文字四至生成的临时粗略边界，非官方红线。
assumptions.statement_en: The submitted overall design area and the three key areas are provisional rough boundaries derived from the announcement's textual limits and are not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: 全部面积、比例与空间关系仅为量级参考；官方 polygon 发布后必须整体重算，包括用地、绿地、公共空间、建筑、道路、分期与全部指标。
assumptions.impact_en: All areas, ratios and spatial relations are order-of-magnitude references; once official polygons are released, land use, green space, public space, buildings, roads, phasing and all metrics must be recomputed as a whole.

assumptions.statement: 容积率、建筑高度、建筑密度、退线、道路红线与设施标准等法定管控条件缺失。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory controls such as FAR, building height, density, setbacks, road redlines and facility standards are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: 相关指标在 metrics.json 中标注为 unknown，正文不给出任何数值；开发强度与道路断面结论须待正式控规条件确认。
assumptions.impact_en: These metrics are marked unknown in metrics.json and no values appear in the narrative; intensity and street-section conclusions await statutory conditions.

assumptions.statement: 具身城市单元 EUZ L1—L4 分级制度是本方案提出的概念工具，尚无对应法定依据或主管部门认可。
assumptions.statement_en: The EUZ L1-L4 grading is a conceptual instrument proposed by this submission and has no statutory basis or authority endorsement.
assumptions.impact: 任何 L3、L4 单元的实际开设必须先经主管部门许可、安全评估、保险安排与公众告知；本方案不得被引用为已获批准的运行规则。
assumptions.impact_en: Opening any L3 or L4 zone requires prior authority permission, safety assessment, insurance and public notice; this proposal must not be cited as an approved operating rule.

assumptions.statement: 缺少现状建筑普查、权属与工程条件，示意建筑基底不代表现状建筑，也不代表拆改留判断。
assumptions.statement_en: Without a building survey, ownership records or engineering conditions, indicative footprints represent neither existing buildings nor retain/renovate/demolish decisions.
assumptions.impact: 建筑基底面积仅表达研究对象规模量级；拆改留只提供四步判定方法，不给出地块级结论。
assumptions.impact_en: Footprint areas express only study-object magnitude; only a four-step method is provided, with no parcel-level conclusion.

assumptions.statement: 清华园车站站房及铁路遗产的法定保护范围未取得，约束图层中的范围为示意提示。
assumptions.statement_en: The statutory protection extent of the Tsinghuayuan station building and rail heritage has not been obtained; the constraints layer shows an indicative alert extent.
assumptions.impact: 所有涉及遗产界面的设计动作必须在取得文物主管部门公布范围后复核，示意范围不得用于避让计算。
assumptions.impact_en: Any design action at the heritage interface must be re-checked against the authority's published extent; the indicative extent must not be used for clearance calculations.

assumptions.statement: 海淀AI产业数据与6个全球案例数据均来自公开报道或机构官网自述，统计口径与时点不完全一致。
assumptions.statement_en: Haidian AI statistics and the six global cases come from public reporting or institutional self-description with inconsistent statistical scope and timing.
assumptions.impact: 这些数据只用于趋势判断与案例比较，不用于范围内推算、评分依据或任何精确结论。
assumptions.impact_en: They support trend judgement and case comparison only, never in-scope extrapolation, scoring evidence or precise conclusions.
